item.title: Providence sports bar temporarily closed after disturbance
item.description: A sports bar in Providence is temporarily closed after an incident happened Saturday evening, according to police.

item.title: Sale of Roger Williams, Fatima hospitals finalized
item.description: Rhode Island Gov. Dan McKee and Attorney General Peter Neronha, along with legislative and health care leaders, held a news conference Friday to mark the sale of the two hospitals to Centurion Foundation, a Georgia-based nonprofit.

item.title: Man arrested after allegedly threatening Providence police chief
item.description: A man has been charged with disorderly conduct and threatening a public official after a car crash with Providence Police Chief Oscar Perez on Friday, according to a spokesperson for the police department.

item.title: Gen. Michael Flynn headlines rally for RI congressional candidate
item.description: Former National Security Advisor Michael Flynn headlined a campaign rally for 2nd Congressional District candidate Vic Mellor.

item.title: Cranston police officer arrested on DUI charge in Coventry
item.description: A Cranston police officer was arrested and charged with suspicion of driving drunk in Coventry Friday night.

item.title: URI women's basketball wins A-10 Tournament, securing first NCAA Tournament bid in 30 years
item.description: The Rams took down reigning conference champions, George Mason, on Sunday afternoon to secure their first conference title in program history.

item.title: 'Faith, family, and fishing': New Bedford fisherman remembered as a doting father
item.description: Makayla and Jose Nieves told 12 News their brother Angel, who was the oldest of four siblings, started fishing with his father at a young age.

item.title: Weather Now: Warmer with Sunshine Monday
item.description: Hey everyone! After a mainly cloudy and rainy weekend, much better weather is on the way for Monday and Tuesday with the warmest temperatures we've seen in several months! More wet weather is possible Wednesday night and Thursday, however, temperatures for most of this week will be above freezing so lots of melting will occur. [...]

item.title: Fundraiser held for victims of Taunton house explosion
item.description: The fundraiser was organized by Taylor Brewer, who lives in the area where the explosion happened, and the Taunton Diversity Network.

item.title: Police investigating apparent stabbing in Pawtucket
item.description: Multiple officers were spotted outside of a home on Sterry Street, where yellow police tape has also been set up to block off a driveway.
